notes.title: Hotfix Update – August 20, 2025
notes.content: [p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the [b]Before the Dawn[/b] development team.[/p][p]In this hotfix, we’ve applied several updates to improve the gameplay experience and UI usability.[/p][p]Please see the detailed update notes below.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]📌 Key Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted certain monster spawn locations and roaming points.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual effects related to sanity loss to enhance fear and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the behavior of settings option UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the functionality of certain features within the UI options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced overall usability for UI and cursor control, including controller support.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain HUD display rules.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain achievements could be cleared abnormally in specific situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some controller tutorials were not displaying correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thank you as always for playing.[/p][p align="start"]Your feedback is a great help in making [i]Before the Dawn[/i] even more polished.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Sincerely, — The Before the Dawn Development Team[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Major Update Announcement – Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119946/436f3b1381958e3562b06c74c08edfceafcdff60.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is Influsion Studio.[/p][p][/p][p]One year after its initial release, [i][b]SAVE Teaser: Before the Dawn[/b][/i] has returned with a major update and has been reborn as [i][b]Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue[/b][/i].[/p][p][/p][p]This update goes beyond simple improvements — it is an expanded version that elevates the overall quality of the game and marks an important milestone that sets the direction for the series.[/p][p]With this update, the quality of graphics, sound, and systems has been significantly enhanced, and new content and improved gameplay, previously unavailable, have been added.[/p][p]Through these changes, players will experience deeper immersion and heightened tension, while also getting an early taste of the atmosphere and gameplay style of the upcoming [i][b]SENARA: The Sacrament[/b].[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue[/b][/i] is more than just a prologue; it is the first step on a journey that heralds the beginning of the series’ universe.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why did we undertake this major update?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]① To meet the expectations for expanding the game’s universe[/b][/p][p]Players who enjoyed [i][b]SAVE[/b][/i] and [i][b]SAVE Teaser[/b][/i] were curious about the incidents and background surrounding the [i]SENARA[/i] ship and the [i]SENARA Gospel Church Mission[/i].[/p][p]While we had prepared various stories, it was difficult to convey everything within the existing game, so we aimed to quench this curiosity by adding new content.[/p][p][/p][p][b]② To connect to the new title, [i]SENARA: The Sacrament[/i][/b]
To overcome these limitations, we began developing a spin-off new title, [i][b]SENARA: The Sacrament[/b][/i], which explores different perspectives and events within the same universe.[/p][p]This new game, a story-driven first-person survival horror, is being developed with a unique atmosphere, immersive storytelling, and multiple endings to offer players a deeply engaging experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]③ To give players an early experience of the new world and systems[/b]
Ahead of the full release of [i][b]SENARA: The Sacrament[/b][/i], we conducted a major update based on the free prologue released one year ago so players can try out some of the new content and systems we have prepared so far.[/p][p]With new features, enhanced visuals, and improved gameplay, the overall quality has been significantly elevated.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Introduction to Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue[/b][/h3][p][b]In this prologue, experience the escape of a lone survivor trapped in crisis while uncovering the truth behind a fanatical cult, all set within a meticulously recreated environment based on the real 6,000-ton [i]SENARA[/i] ship.[/b][/p][p]With this update, we have improved various elements such as [u]the map and journal and added new content[/u] to faithfully capture the essence of a first-person survival horror game.[/p][p]Explore the confined ship, search for clues, and evade the watchers’ eyes as you get closer to uncovering the truth behind the incident — play and experience it yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Brief Introduction to SENARA: The Sacrament[/b][/h3][p][b][i]SENARA: The Sacrament[/i][/b] is a story-driven first-person survival horror set aboard a large ship, exploring themes of faith, fanaticism, and abyssal terror.[/p][p]Players find themselves mysteriously left alone on the [i]SENARA[/i], forced to survive and escape as the ship faces the threat of sinking.[/p][p]Survivors with various motives, forbidden cult rituals, and hidden truths await you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎯 Add the game to your wishlist on the store page now and stay updated with the latest news.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3915120/SENARA_The_Sacrament"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119946/a8c5d019600e0d8b33671b4fccfd118a48461b1e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]In closing,[/b][/h3][p]We sincerely thank all of you who have supported and loved the [i]SAVE[/i] and [i]SENARA[/i] series.[/p][p]Through this update of [i][b]Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue[/b][/i], we hope you experience even deeper fear and immersion, and we look forward to growing together with you.[/p][p]If you have any questions or concerns while playing, please share them in our community.[/p][p]Your valuable feedback is a great help in making the game better.[/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm![/p][p][/p][p]— From all of us at Influsion Studio[/p]
